summary: Plain residential kerb between two junctions; homes 15-20 m away, steep.
reasons: Quiet residential street, no parking convention

best_section.where: Mid-block on the west kerb, beside the vacant garden

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 15-22 m away on both sides of the section; a vacant yard sits on the west side but houses overlook it.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a grass/dirt verge on the west side wide enough for a van to pull off the lane.
drivers.traffic: Short quiet street linking two cross streets; low traffic.
drivers.convention: A couple of cars park on the east kerb near the south end; no sign of overnight stays.

sun_shade: Mostly open; some garden trees shade the west verge in the afternoon.
